_comment: Human-facing surfaces outside the PSP Human Card Table. `cards` are individual cards Fernando ruled human-facing; `tables` are whole card tables whose every card is one. The guard enforces the sister-card contract on both. A card the intake agent adopts is appended to `cards`; the `tables` entry is the backstop for one it forgets.

cards.title: [iOS] To-dos pagination
cards.reason: Fernando: 'Let's treat this card as the human-facing card' — no sister card for this effort, so the summary lands here on a shared team board.

tables.title: Issues — Mobile: On Call
tables.reason: Intake runs on this board with the source card as its own human surface, so every card on it can become one. Adopted cards are appended to `cards` too; this entry means a missed append does not silently un-gate the contract.
